title: Borel measurability of the Gram-determinant Jacobian √det(⟨DΦ(w)e_i, DΦ(w)e_j⟩) of an arbitrary map ℝⁿ → ℝ^P
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be an arbitrary map, with no regularity assumed. Here ℝᵏ = Eucl k = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k), DΦ(w) = fderiv ℝ Φ w (which is 0 where Φ is not differentiable) and e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1. Then the function w ↦ √det(⟨DΦ(w)e_i, DΦ(w)e_j⟩)_{i,j<n} is Borel measurable on ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P), Measurable (fun w : Eucl n => Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det)
